text.body:
śaiśirīya śikṣā hariḥ śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ avighnamastu hariḥ śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ avighnamastu gajānanāya śrīśāya sarvavighnapraṇāśine namo gaṇeśarūpāya viṣṇave daśabāhave jagatsaṃbhūtisaṃrakṣā saṃhāraikavinodine namo bhagavate tasmai cidānandāya viṣṇave mudgalo gālavo gārgyaḥ śākalyaḥ śaiśirastathā pañcaite śaunakāḥ śiṣyāḥ śākhābhedapravartakāḥ śaiśirasya tu śiṣyasya śākaṭāyana eva ca sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāramācāryaṃ tu praṇamya ca śaiśiro'haṃ pravakṣyāmi śākhāyā lakṣaṇaṃ vidhim triṣaṣṭiścatuḥṣaṣṭirvā varṇāḥ saṃbhavato matāḥ prākṛte saṃskṛte vāpi svayaṃ proktāḥ svayaṃbhuvā svarā viṃśatirekaśca sparśānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ yādayaśca smṛtā hyaṣṭau catvārastu yamāḥ smṛtāḥ anusvāro visargaśca lakāraśca tathaiva ca duspṛṣṭaśceti vijñeyo nāsikyaṃ raṅgamucyate uccāraṇaviśeṣeṇātrākṣarāśrayamucyate dvividhaṃ varṇajātaṃ hi svaro vyañjanameva ca akārādiḥ svaro jñeyaḥ kādi vyañjanamucyate dvividhaśca svaro jñeyo nāsikyaḥ sānunāsikaḥ udāttaścānudāttaśca svaritaḥ pracayastathā kādīnāṃ pañcavargāśca sparśā iti hi saṃjñitāḥ duspṛṣṭaśceti vijñeyo ḍaḍhayoḥ svaramadhyayoḥ vargāṇāṃ prathamā varṇā dvitīyā ūṣmasaṃjñitāḥ hakāravarjyāścāghoṣāḥ śiṣṭaṃ ghoṣavaducyate nāsikyāḥ pañcamā varṇā anusvārastathaiva ca catvārastu yamāḥ proktā avyaktāḥ sānunāsikāḥ catasro yādayontasthā nāsikyā apyarephikāḥ ūṣmāṇaḥ śādayaścaiva catvāra iti kīrtitāḥ jihvāmūlīya ityukta upadhmānīya eva ca kapāśritoṣmajātau ca visargasya ca saṃbhavau hrasvo dīrghaḥ pluta iti svarāḥ kālena saṃjñitāḥ sandhyakṣarāṇāṃ kālaśca dīrghaḥpluto na mātrikaḥ uccāraṇaviśeṣeṇātrākṣarāśrayamucyate vyañjanaṃ tvardhamātraṃ syāt svarabhaktistathaiva ca saṃyoge pādamātrā syāt svarabhaktiḥ prakīrtyate hrasvāt parastvanusvārastripādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ sa ca hrasvastripādaḥ syād dvāvetau samamātrikau dīrghāt parastvanusvāraḥ pādamātraḥ prakīrtitaḥ sa ca dīrghaḥ sapādaḥ syādvarṇakālo nigadyate aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānāmuraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śirastathā jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikoṣṭau ca tālu ca akuhāḥ kaṇṭhajāḥ proktā upadhmānīya oṣṭhajaḥ upū oṣṭyau vijānīyādvo dantyoṣṭyastathaiva ca e ai tu kaṇṭhatālavyau o au kaṇṭhoṣṭhajau smṛtau sparśānāṃ karaṇaṃ spṛṣṭamantasthāsvīṣaducyate svarāṇāmūṣmaṇāṃ caiva vivṛtaṃ karaṇaṃ smṛtam saṃvṛtaṃ cetyakārasya sarvavarṇo nigadyate uccāraṇaviśeṣeṇātrākṣarāśrayamucyate anusvāre vivṛtyante virāme cākṣaradvaye ovarṇe ca uvarṇe ca pavarge ca pṛthak pṛthak o au uvarṇa ityeṣāmanusvārapavargayoḥ virāme ca vivṛttau ca madhye ca vyañjanadvaye dviroṣṭhau tu vigṛhṇīyādvakāre tvadharaṃ tathā suūtayo bhrātuḥ putrāndhenuṃ somaḥ pra suṣṭutiḥ yanmayobhu udīraya pupuṣvān moṣṭavo asamā babhūvuḥ śvo vocemahītyetādṛśaṃ nidarśanam o au uvarṇa ityeṣāṃ vyañjanasya ca saṃgatau sakṛdoṣṭau vigṛhṇīyānnānyaścenmadhyagaḥ svaraḥ dviṣo yuyotu yūyuvirityetattannidarśanam katavā yatra dṛśyante sandhisthāneṣu nityaśaḥ svavargeṇa niyuktāśca vīrantatraiva kārayet hiṅkṛṇvatī tatte bhadraṃ gāṃ bhajanta nidarśanam sparśānāṃ pañcamairyoge bhavantīha yamāḥ smṛtāḥ ayaḥ piṇḍena tattulyaṃ ghanabandhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ saḥ paliknīragniryajñaṃ patnirvidma dadhmātmānaṃ pāpmājagṛbhmāgṛbhṇāmityetannidarśanam sparśāstvapañcamāścaivamantasthābhiśca saṃyutāḥ dārupiṇḍena tattulyaṃ ślathabandhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ śatruṃ sakhyamagryaṃ kṛcchraṃ kva vajraṃ yajvā rāṣṭryati plāyogirviddhirmeḍhraṃvādhryaśveti nidarśanam vakārastu nakāreṇa ṇakāreṇa ca saṃyutaḥ ślathabandhaḥ sa vijñeyo duspṛṣṭaścātra cocyate bhūridāvnaḥ evayāvnaḥ prātaryāvṇaḥ dadhikrāvṇaḥ īle dyāvāpṛthivīmīlhe saptirityatra tu nidarśanam saṃyoge śaṣasāḥ pūrve paraṃ cedanunāsikam ūrṇāpiṇḍena tattulyaṃ ślathabandhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ aśnotu viṣṇurghṛtasnūkārṣmeveti nidarśanam parasparastu saṃyogaḥ sparśānāṃ saṃbhavedyadi tatpūrvasya śrutirnāsti virāme vyañjanasya ca vāgdevīviṭ kulādvibhrāḍ bṛhadāraik panthām yadghnan triṣṭubgāyatrī asmādanuṣṭubiti nidarśanam nakārāntaṃ padaṃ pūrvaṃ yavakāre pare pade asaṃyutaṃ tu vijñeyamubhayorvyaktiriṣyate saṃyutau yavakārau cedṛkāraḥ parato yadi saṃyutaṃ tvatravijñeyaṃ nobhayorvyaktiriṣyate anusvārasvarādyastu saṃyogādirdvirucyate ūṣmā cetprathamau jñeyau lāt sparśo raparastathā tvaṃ śraddhābhīrathaṃ svasti vajramagramātvārathaṃ ādvābhyāmīdhyasva vibhvīssahaskṛta kaśchandasāṃ paścāt suṣṭubhastiṣṭhanti śulkākastadastā divaspari śulkā ulkāmiva galdayāmarccativardhantānditaṃ punaryandhapūrvamairthaśca tadatra tu nidarśanam yadyūṣmānupadho yuktaḥ sa cedyantasthayā punaḥ tasyaiva kramaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śyāvāḥ svāhā śriye hvaye naṭābhyāṃ se pare madhye takāraḥ saṃprajāyate natayorle cavarge ca savarṇaḥ syāt parasya tu ta evādukahemañca vṛttaścākāraḥ śrūyate āpaḥ kṣiptaṃ ca yacchabdaṃ prathamoccāraṇalakṣaṇam sasavāntsantstūyase virāṭtsamrāṭ yasmim̐lloke nṝñjātairiti tallokamasmācceti nidarśanam anantyāḥ prathamā varṇā ghoṣasaṃjñe pare sthite varṇā dvitīyānucyante ucyante varṇavedibhiḥ dvayoḥ pādukahemañca vṛttaścākāra śrūyate āpaḥ kṣiptaṃ ca yacchabdaṃ dvitīyoccāraṇalakṣaṇam vṛkhṣe vṛkhṣe saṃvathsaraṃ tvānthsāri tamaphsanta camathsaraḥ mathsyapāyītyetattu nidarśanam yathāsau mattamātaṅgaḥ padātpadamavakramī evaṃ padaṃ padasyānte darśanīyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ralau svarād yatra pūrvā ūṣmasaṃjñe pare sthite pūrvasvarasya saṃbhāvyā svarabhaktiḥ prakīrtyate adarśi śīrṣā agnirhotā sarsṛte ca na jalhavaḥ śatavalśo'rṣā ṇo'rṣannetadatra nidarśanam vyañjanānteṣu yukteṣu saiva syāt pādamātrikā śīrṣṇaḥśīrṣṇaḥ prasarsrāṇaḥ tarhyevaitannidarśanam svarabhaktiṃ prayuñjānaḥ trīn doṣān parivarjayet ikāraṃ cāpyukāraṃ ca grastadoṣantathaiva ca yakārarephāvityetā vṛkāreṇa ca saṃyutau oṣṭhau tatra na kaṃpyete kṣiprametatpracakṣate pra kṛtānyṛjīṣiṇaḥ vajryṛcīṣamaḥ śamyṛkvāṇaḥ niṛrthan niṛrteścāpi nidarśanamitīdṛśam visarjanīyasya yadā kapayoḥ parataḥ sthitiḥ na saṃhitāyāṃ bhavata ūṣmajātau parigrahe jyotiṣkṛdyātaṃ chardiṣpāvimamañjaspāmubhaye haviṣkṛtaṃ pathaspatha ityatra tu nidarśanam nīcaiḥ svaro'nudāttaḥ syāduccaiścodātta ucyate svaritaṃ tatsamāhārastadaikyaṃ pracayaḥ smṛtaḥ anudātto hṛdi jñeyo mūrdhnyudātta ucyate svaritaḥ karṇamūlīyaḥ sarvasmin pracayastathā imaṃ me gaṃge yamune sarasvati nidarśanam udāttaścānudāttaśca svaritaśca tathaiva ca lakṣaṇaṃ varṇayiṣyāmi daivataṃ rathānameva ca śuklamuccaṃ vijānīyāt nīcaṃ lohitamucyate śyāmaṃ tu svaritaṃ vidyādagniruccasya devatā nīce somaṃ vijānīyāt svarite savitā tathā udāttaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidyānnīcaṃ kṣatriyamucyate vaiśyaṃ tu svaritaṃ vidyādudāttantu bharadvasuḥ nīcaṃ gautamamityāhurgārgyaṃ tu svaritaṃ viduḥ vidyādudāttaṃ gāyatraṃ nīcaṃ traiṣṭubhamucyate jāgataṃ svaritaṃ vidyādetadeva niyogataḥ madhye tu kaṃpayet kaṃpamubhau pārśvau samau bhavet dviguṇaṃ varṇakālācca pādaḥ kaṃpārtha iṣyate anudāttamupādāya svaritaṃ hyavalaṃbayet punarnihatamāgacched eṣa kaṃpavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ kva1vo'śvā yujāno3'smābhistvāṃ hī3ndreti nidarśanam saraṅgaṃ kampayet kampaṃ rathīveti nidarśanam udāttaḥ uccau niṣādagandhārau nīcāvṛṣabhadhaivatau śeṣāstu svaritā jñeyāḥ ṣaḍjamadhyamapañcamāḥ udāttamākhyāti vṛṣo'ṅgulīnāṃ pradeśinīmūlaniṣṭamūrdhā antye ca madhye ca svaritaṃ dhṛtaśca va eko'rvāñco adyarathaṃ hiraṇyapraugam dhṛtavratā ādityāścaitattatra nidarśanam svarabhaktiṃ prayuñjānastrīn doṣān parivarjayet ikāraṃ cāpyukāraṃ ca grastadoṣaṃ tathaiva ca na ca svarati pūrvāṅge nāparāṅge kathaṃ cana na svare na ca mātrāyāṃ kathaṃ svāro vidhīyate parāṅgasya tu yat pūrve pūrvāṅgasya tu yat param ubhayārdhārdhasaṃyoge svāraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ durbalasya yathā rāṣṭraṃ harettad balavānnṛpaḥ durbalaṃ vyañjanaṃ tadvaddhared balavān svaraḥ mātrikaṃ vā dvimātraṃ vā svaryate yadihākṣaram tasyāntatordhamātrāṃ vai mātrādhikyaṃ tathaiva sā obhāvaśca vivṛttiśca śaṣasā repha eva ca jihvāmūlamupadhmā ca gatiraṣṭavidhoṣmaṇaḥ yadyobhāvaprasandhānamukārādi paraṃ padam svarāntaṃ tādṛśaṃ vidyādyadanyadvyaktamūṣmaṇaḥ svarāḥ kampāśca raṅgāśca ye yatkālāḥ svabhāvataḥ vardhante procyamānāste kṣiprayatne vivaktari yakārastrividhaḥ prokto gururlaghurlaghūttaraḥ ādau gururlaghurmadhye padānte ca laghūtaraḥ pādādau ca padādau ca saṃyogāvagraheṣu ca jaḥ śabda iti vijñeyo anyatra ya iti smṛtaḥ ekamakṣarametacca ca padāntavat mādhuryaṃ ca na cāvyaktaṃ vyaktaṃ ca na ca piṇḍayet sanāthasyeva deśasya na varṇāssaṃkaraṃ gatāḥ gītī śīghrī śiraḥkampī tathā likhitapāṭhakaḥ anarthajñolpakaṇṭhaśca ṣaḍete pāṭhakādhamāḥ mādhuryamakṣaravyaktaṃ padavyaktaṃ tu susvaram dhairyaṃ laghusamāyuktaṃ ṣaḍete pāṭhake guṇāḥ rākṣeti prathamo jñeyaḥ khnā ityaparo bhavet yamāstatra nivartante śmaśānādiva bāndhavāḥ prathamottamavargīye vargyāntyaissaha saṃgate nāsikyaṃ gurumuccāryaṃ yamasthānagataṃ vadet nādastu śrūyate ghoṣādvirāmād dvitvatastathā anāsikyo'tha nāsikyo jāyate varṇarūpataḥ dadhyaṅ ha parame vyoman vīryaṃ ceti nidarśanam nakārasya padāntasya svare repho vidhīyate lopastvākārapūrvasya saśau tu tacayoḥ pare sakhīm̐ryān ut paṇīm̐rhatam tādṛśaṃ rañjayedaṅgaṃ sarvaṃ nāsikyasaṃgatam lākṣāraktaṃ yathā toyaṃ nakārāṅgasvaraṃ tathā sarvaraṅgaṃ vijānīyādbandhūm̐ riti nidarśanam hṛdayādutthitaṃ raṅgaṃ kāṃsyena samasusvaram mātrikaṃ ca dvimātraṃ ca jaghanbām̐ iti nidarśanam yathā saurāṣṭrikā nārī takrām̐ ityabhidhīyate evaṃ raṅgāḥ prayoktavyāḥ khe arām̐ iva śvedayā lupte nakāre yat svaraṃ rañjanti śaunakādayaḥ ādisarvaraṅgamiti proktaṃ na tvā bhīriva vindatīm̐3 sapta svarān pravakṣyāmi teṣāmeva tu lakṣaṇam jātyaḥ kṣaiprobhinihitastairovyañjana eva ca jātyaḥ svaraḥ sajātyena śruṣṭyagne kṣaipra ucyate te'vardhantābhinihitastairovyañjana ūtaye tirovirāmo viṣkabhite praśliṣṭo hīndragirvaṇaḥ pādavṛttaḥ ka riṃ veda svarāssaptaivamādayaḥ jātyādiḥ pādavṛttāntaḥ svaritaśca svarāstrayaḥ udāttaḥ pūrvasandhau yo nīcairabhipade sthitaḥ anudāttaḥ paraḥ śeṣaḥ śākalādyaiḥ pracoditaḥ tasyaivodāttaśravaṇaṃ kampasthāne'rdhamātrakam kṛtrime tu padāntādyorbahudhā ṛkṣu bhidyate lopāgamavikārādi viśeṣeṇa tvṛci kramāt yatra triṃśat samāmnātāssaṃyoga upayoginaḥ varṇā ṛgveda ācāryaiḥ sparśāntasthoṣmabhedataḥ trīṇi triṣu tridhātūni yat kiñcidupari śrutam antarikṣaṃ purīṣyaṃ ca etadvivṛtalakṣaṇam bahiśśritaḥ pṛthagdṛśaśvṛkadṛṣirvṛṣabaḥ bṛhantriṣu varṣāṇyetat saṃvṛtalakṣaṇam sparśāṇāṃ tu saha sparśaiḥ saṃyogo yo bhavenmithaḥ pūrvasya sandhṛtirvaktre na tu tasyeṣyate śrutiḥ parasparaṃ tu saṃyogaḥ sparśānāṃ saṃbhavedyadi tatpūrvasya śrutirnāsti virāme vyañjanasya ca kakudmān yadghnanbhinadmītyatra dārṇasya sandhṛtiḥ agniḥ paliknīḥ śvaghnīva dhriyante gakaghākṣarāḥ vāgdevī vākpūtā viṭkulādvibhrāḍbṛhadāraik panthāṃ yadghnan triṣṭubgāyatryarvāk antasthābhiśca saṃyutaḥ vargāṇāṃ prathamo varṇaḥ pañcame sārvavarṇike udaye pañcamasya syāt na cakāraḥ padāntagaḥ arvāgdevā vibhrāḍbṛhat bṛhadbhirvājaistriṣṭubbhiḥ arvāgrathaṃ samrāḍvibhvīrgomadyūyamudrebhañca arvāṅ narāvirāṇ mitrāvaruṇayoḥ śramannota trikakumnivartaditi cāpyatra tu nidarśanam padāntīyācca vargāderhakāro yaḥ paro bhavet pūrvasyaiva caturtho yo hakārastaṃ samāpnuyāt prathamaṃ tu hakāraśca taccaturthamavāpyate svatṛtīyamavāpnoti pūrvavarṇastathā hi saḥ ṛdhagdhuvemasamrāḍḍhantākaddhanūnaṃ triṣṭubbhitāḥ cakāro na padāntosti atosau nopadiśyate makārasya padāntasya rephoṣmasu pareṣu ca anusvāro bhavatyeva padamadhyagateṣvapi tvaṃ rathaṃ taṃ hinvanti tvaṃ śukrasya tāṃ su te kīrtim samānodayodarkaṃ ṣaṣṭhe'hanimāṃsamekaḥ piṃśati cakṣūṃṣi maṃhiṣṭho
